name: io.github.EzequielLech/chainguard-mcp
title: ChainGuard Web3 Security & DeFi MCP
description: 15-tool Web3 security firewall, EIP-7702 & Solana Token-2022 auditor, approval revoker & DeFi sweep.

tools.name: check_eip7702_delegation
tools.description: Inspect a single EVM externally owned account (EOA) via live eth_getCode RPC to detect active Pectra EIP-7702 delegation hijacks (0xef0100...23-byte designator). Read-only, non-destructive lookup on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, or Polygon (5 free calls/hour per IP or unlimited with X-API-Key). Returns JSON with `address`, `network`, `delegated` (boolean), `delegate_contract` (0x address or null), `risk_score` (0-100), and `verdict` (`PASS`, `WARN`, `BLOCK`). Use this tool for targeted single-address EOA code checks; use `scan_evm_dust_and_hygiene` for full 8-chain token balance and dust discovery.

address.description: 42-character hexadecimal EVM wallet address (`0x` followed by 40 hex chars) to inspect for EIP-7702 bytecode delegation.

network.description: Target EVM chain for live `eth_getCode` inspection (`base`, `ethereum`, `arbitrum`, or `polygon`). Defaults to `base`.

tools.name: check_solana_token2022
tools.description: Inspect a Solana SPL or Token-2022 mint account via live Solana mainnet RPC and RugCheck to detect `PermanentDelegate` drain authorities, arbitrary `TransferHook` programs, active `FreezeAuthority`/`MintAuthority`, and hidden transfer fee basis points. Read-only, non-destructive analysis (5 free calls/hour per IP or unlimited with X-API-Key). Returns JSON with `mint`, `program`, `permanent_delegate`, `transfer_hook`, `freeze_authority`, `risk_score` (0-100), and `verdict` (`PASS`, `WARN`, `BLOCK`). Use this tool for deep Solana mint extension inspection; use `analyze_token_alpha` when you also need DexScreener price, liquidity, and 24h volume.

mint.description: Base58-encoded Solana SPL or Token-2022 mint address (32-44 characters, e.g. `EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v`).

tools.name: check_tx_firewall
tools.description: Perform a read-only pre-flight security check on an unsigned EVM transaction (`to`, `calldata`, `network`) before signing or broadcasting. Screens 4-byte function selectors against unlimited ERC-20 `approve(MAX_UINT256)` (`0x095ea7b3`), NFT `setApprovalForAll(true)` (`0xa22cb465`), Permit2 drainer signatures (`0xd505accf`), UUPS proxy upgrades (`0x3659cfe6`), and verifies whether the spender is an unverified EOA via `eth_getCode`. Does not broadcast any transaction. Returns JSON with `verdict` (`ALLOW`, `WARN`, `BLOCK`), `risk_score` (0-100), decoded `selector`, and actionable `alerts`.

to.description: 42-character hexadecimal target contract or recipient address (`0x...`) of the unsigned EVM transaction.

network.description: EVM network identifier where the transaction will be executed (`base`, `arbitrum`, `polygon`, `ethereum`, `optimism`, `bsc`). Defaults to `base`.

calldata.description: Hex-encoded transaction input data starting with `0x` (e.g. `0x095ea7b3...`). Pass `0x` for native value transfers.

tools.name: check_mcp_poisoning
tools.description: Scan untrusted runtime text, MCP tool descriptions, or prompt payloads for invisible zero-width/bidirectional Unicode smuggling (`U+200B`..`U+202E`), prompt-injection override directives, and exposed 64-byte Solana keypairs or private keys. Purely read-only static text inspection with zero code execution (5 free calls/hour per IP or unlimited with X-API-Key). Returns JSON with `verdict` (`ALLOW`, `WARN`, `BLOCK`), `risk_score` (0-100), and matched `findings`. Use this tool for runtime prompt and tool-description hygiene; use `audit_solidity_or_mcp` for full Solidity smart contract or JSON config file audits.

text.description: Raw untrusted text, MCP tool description, or prompt string to scan for invisible Unicode characters, prompt injection, and leaked secrets.

tools.name: audit_solidity_or_mcp
tools.description: Run a read-only static security and token-efficiency audit on Solidity smart contract source code (`.sol`) or MCP server JSON configuration files. Detects reentrancy, `tx.origin` auth, unchecked external calls, uninitialized proxies, and redundant prompt token bloat without executing the submitted code (5 free calls/hour per IP or unlimited with X-API-Key). Returns JSON with `risk_score` (0-100), `severity_counts`, `findings` (with remediation patches), and `estimated_savings_usd`. Use this tool for source-code and config auditing; use `check_mcp_poisoning` for fast runtime prompt-injection screening.

content.description: Full Solidity smart contract source code (`pragma solidity ...`) or JSON/YAML MCP server configuration content to audit statically.

target_type.description: Analyzer mode: `solidity` for EVM smart contracts, `mcp` for agent configurations, or `auto` to auto-detect from syntax. Defaults to `auto`.

tools.name: reclaim_solana_rent
tools.description: Scan a Solana wallet via live mainnet RPC for empty 0-balance SPL and Token-2022 token accounts (~0.002039 SOL trapped rent per account) and optionally construct an unsigned base64 `CloseAccount` batch transaction. Read-only and non-custodial: never broadcasts or signs transactions (unlimited free calls; user receives +88% net reclaimed SOL when they sign and broadcast, with a 12% atomic recovery fee). Returns JSON with `wallet`, `empty_closable_accounts`, `reclaimable_sol`, `estimated_net_user_sol`, and `unsigned_tx_base64` (up to 15 accounts per atomic tx).

wallet.description: Base58-encoded Solana wallet public key (32-44 chars) to scan for empty 0-balance SPL and Token-2022 token accounts.

build_tx.description: When `true` (default) and closable empty accounts exist, fetches a recent mainnet blockhash and includes `unsigned_tx_base64` ready for wallet signing.

tools.name: check_frontend_hijack
tools.description: Inspect a live DeFi web application HTTPS URL and optional EIP-1967 proxy contract for supply-chain hijack indicators: missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP), external `<script>` tags lacking Subresource Integrity (`integrity="sha384-..."`), suspicious third-party domains, and EIP-1967 implementation slot state. Read-only inspection over HTTPS and EVM RPC (5 free calls/hour per IP or unlimited with X-API-Key). Returns JSON with `url`, `hijack_risk_score` (0-100), `verdict` (`PASS`, `WARN`, `BLOCK`), `scripts_analyzed`, `missing_sri_count`, and `proxy_implementation`.

url.description: Full `https://` URL of the DeFi web application frontend to inspect for script integrity and HTTP security headers (e.g. `https://app.uniswap.org`).

proxy.description: Optional 42-character EVM EIP-1967 proxy contract address (`0x...`) to read its on-chain implementation slot (`0x360894...`). Leave empty to skip proxy check.

network.description: EVM network for reading the optional EIP-1967 proxy contract (`base`, `ethereum`, `arbitrum`, `polygon`, `optimism`, `bsc`). Defaults to `base`.

tools.name: scan_evm_dust_and_hygiene
tools.description: Scan an EVM wallet across up to 8 chains (`base`, `arbitrum`, `optimism`, `polygon`, `ethereum`, `bsc`, `linea`, `avalanche`) to discover all ERC-20 token holdings priced in USD, identify sweepable non-stablecoin dust tokens, and summarize open unlimited router approvals. Read-only, zero-connect multi-chain portfolio lookup with unlimited free calls. Returns JSON with `address`, `total_sweepable_usd`, `stable_balances_usd`, per-token `holdings` (`token_address`, `symbol`, `amount_raw`, `usd_value`, `network`), and `approval_risks`. Use this tool to discover token balances and `amount_raw` before calling `build_evm_dust_to_usdt_sweep`, `build_cross_chain_consolidation`, or `build_erc20_approval_revoke`.

address.description: 42-character hexadecimal EVM wallet address (`0x...`) to scan for ERC-20 dust balances and open router allowances.

networks.description: Comma-separated list of EVM networks to scan (choose from `base`, `arbitrum`, `optimism`, `polygon`, `ethereum`, `bsc`, `linea`, `avalanche`).

tools.name: build_erc20_approval_revoke
tools.description: Construct unsigned non-custodial EVM calldata (`approve(spender, 0)`, selector `0x095ea7b3`) to revoke an open ERC-20 token allowance granted to a router or spender contract on any of 8 EVM networks. Read-only calldata generator: never signs or broadcasts transactions (unlimited free calls, 0% fee). Returns JSON with `network`, `to` (token contract), `spender`, `data` (68-byte hex calldata), `value` (`0x0`), and `eip5792_call` ready for wallet signing.

token_address.description: 42-character hexadecimal ERC-20 token contract address (`0x...`) whose allowance will be reset to zero.

spender.description: 42-character hexadecimal router or spender contract address (`0x...`) whose spending permission is being revoked.

network.description: Target EVM chain where the ERC-20 allowance exists. Defaults to `base`.

tools.name: build_evm_dust_to_usdt_sweep
tools.description: Build unsigned non-custodial SAME-CHAIN swap calldata (exact-amount ERC-20 `approve` + audited KyberSwap/OpenOcean router swap) converting an ERC-20 token into USDT or USDC on the SAME EVM network (`base`, `arbitrum`, `optimism`, `polygon`, `ethereum`, `bsc`, `linea`, or `avalanche`). Read-only calldata builder: does not sign or broadcast transactions (unlimited free calls; embeds a 1.00% on-chain integrator fee). Returns JSON with `approve_tx`, `swap_tx`, `eip5792_calls`, `estimated_out_usd`, and `provider`. Use this tool when input token and output stablecoin remain on the SAME chain; use `build_cross_chain_consolidation` when bridging between two DIFFERENT chains.

network.description: Single EVM chain on which both `token_in` and the output `target_stable` reside. Defaults to `base`.

token_in.description: 42-character hexadecimal ERC-20 contract address (`0x...`) of the token to swap on `network`.

amount_in_raw.description: Exact input amount in atomic base units (wei/smallest integer unit as a decimal string, e.g. `1000000000000000000` for 1.0 18-decimal token).

sender.description: 42-character hexadecimal EVM wallet address (`0x...`) that owns `token_in` and will receive the output USDT/USDC.

target_stable.description: Destination stablecoin symbol on the same network (`USDT` or `USDC`). Defaults to `USDT`.

tools.name: build_cross_chain_consolidation
tools.description: Build unsigned non-custodial CROSS-CHAIN bridge and swap calldata via LI.FI Diamond moving an ERC-20 or native token from `from_network` to a DIFFERENT destination `to_network` (settling in `USDC`, `USDT`, or destination `NATIVE` gas across `base`, `arbitrum`, `optimism`, `polygon`, `ethereum`, `bsc`, `linea`, `avalanche`). Read-only calldata builder: does not sign or broadcast transactions (unlimited free calls; includes a 1.00% atomic integrator fee). Returns JSON with `from_network`, `to_network`, `approve_tx`, `bridge_tx`, `estimated_out_usd`, and `execution_duration_sec`. Use this tool only when bridging across two DIFFERENT networks; use `build_evm_dust_to_usdt_sweep` for same-chain swaps.

from_network.description: Source EVM chain where the token currently resides (must differ from `to_network`).

to_network.description: Destination EVM chain to receive the bridged stablecoin or native gas. Defaults to `base`.

token_in.description: 42-character hexadecimal ERC-20 token contract address (`0x...`) on `from_network` (or `0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000` for native gas).

amount_in_raw.description: Input token amount in atomic base units (wei integer formatted as a decimal string, e.g. `10000000` for 10 USDC).

sender.description: 42-character hexadecimal EVM wallet address (`0x...`) initiating the bridge on `from_network` and receiving funds on `to_network`.

target_stable.description: Output asset on `to_network`: `USDC`, `USDT`, or `NATIVE` (for emergency cross-chain gas refuel). Defaults to `USDC`.

tools.name: find_best_defi_yields
tools.description: Query live DeFiLlama yield pools across Base, Arbitrum, Solana, Ethereum, Optimism, Polygon, and BSC ranked by risk-adjusted sustainable APY and TVL safety score. Read-only market scan (5 free calls/hour per IP returning top 3 pools; full top-25 available via X-API-Key or $0.02 USDC x402 API). Returns JSON with `count`, `chain_filter`, `asset_filter`, and `pools` array (`project`, `symbol`, `chain`, `apy_total`, `apy_base`, `tvl_usd`, `safety_score`, `il_risk`).

asset.description: Token symbol substring filter (e.g. `USDC`, `USDT`, `ETH`, `SOL`, or empty string for any asset). Defaults to `USDC`.

min_tvl_usd.description: Minimum pool Total Value Locked (TVL) in USD required for inclusion. Defaults to `1000000` ($1M).

no_il_only.description: When `true` (default), restricts results to single-sided lending/staking or correlated pools with zero impermanent loss risk.

tools.name: analyze_token_alpha
tools.description: Aggregate live DexScreener market metrics (USD price, liquidity, FDV, 24h volume, 24h buy/sell order-flow ratio) with GoPlus ERC-20 honeypot/tax checks (for EVM `0x...` tokens) or Token-2022/RugCheck checks (for Solana base58 mints). Read-only composite market + security lookup (5 free calls/hour per IP or unlimited with X-API-Key). Returns JSON with `chain`, `market` (`price_usd`, `liquidity_usd`, `fdv_usd`, `volume_24h_usd`, `buy_pressure_pct`), `security`, `combined_risk_score` (0-100), and `verdict` (`PASS`, `WARN`, `BLOCK`). Use this tool for pre-trade market + security evaluation; use `check_solana_token2022` when you only need raw Solana mint authority inspection without market data.

token.description: 42-character EVM ERC-20 contract address (`0x...`) or 32-44 character base58 Solana mint address to analyze.

network.description: Optional chain hint (`base`, `arbitrum`, `ethereum`, `polygon`, `bsc`, `solana`). Leave empty to auto-detect from address format and DexScreener top pair.

tools.name: create_usdt_invoice
tools.description: Create a new non-custodial multi-chain USDT/USDC payment invoice and hosted checkout page on Polygon, BSC, Arbitrum, Base, Ethereum, or Solana settling 100% directly to `merchant_wallet` with 0% platform custody. State-changing operation creating a single-use `pending` invoice record (unlimited free calls, no authentication required). Supports recurring SaaS subscriptions via optional `customer_ref` and `billing_days`. Returns JSON with `ok` (boolean), `checkout_url` (hosted payment page), and `invoice` (`invoice_id`, `status`, `amount_usd`, `network`, `merchant_wallet`, `expires_at`).

title.description: Human-readable product, order, or subscription plan title displayed on the hosted checkout page (2-140 chars).

amount_usd.description: Exact invoice price denominated in USD (settled 1:1 in USDT or USDC on-chain, e.g. `19.0`). Must be >= `0.01`.

network.description: Settlement blockchain network (`polygon`, `bsc`, `base`, `arbitrum`, `ethereum`, `solana`, or `bitcoin`). Defaults to `polygon`.

merchant_wallet.description: Merchant's self-custody receiving wallet address (`0x...` for EVM chains or base58 public key for `solana`). Funds transfer directly here.

webhook_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL to receive an HMAC-SHA256 signed `invoice.paid` POST webhook upon on-chain settlement.

ttl_minutes.description: Invoice expiration window in minutes (`5` to `43200`). After `ttl_minutes`, unpaid invoices cannot be settled. Defaults to `60`.

customer_ref.description: Optional external customer identifier (e.g. email, user ID, or Telegram ID) for tracking recurring subscription status.

billing_days.description: Optional subscription duration in days (e.g. `30` for monthly, `365` for annual). Pass `0` for one-time purchases.

tools.name: verify_usdt_invoice
tools.description: Verify and settle a confirmed on-chain USDT/USDC transaction hash (`tx_hash`) against a PayGate `invoice_id` via live JSON-RPC receipt log inspection. Idempotent state-changing operation (unlimited free calls, anti-replay enforced): confirms recipient address, token contract, and minimum USD amount, transitions the invoice to `paid`, extends recurring `subscription_expires_at` if configured, and dispatches any configured webhook. Returns JSON with `ok` (boolean), `already_paid` (boolean), and updated `invoice` object.

invoice_id.description: Unique PayGate invoice identifier returned by `create_usdt_invoice` (e.g. `inv_a1b2c3d4e5f6`).

tx_hash.description: Confirmed on-chain transaction hash (`0x...` 66-char hex on EVM chains or base58 signature on Solana) transferring USDT/USDC to the invoice's `merchant_wallet`.
